# thief: Temporal HIErarchical Forecasting

[![Travis-CI Build
Status](https://travis-ci.org/robjhyndman/thief.svg?branch=master)](https://travis-ci.org/robjhyndman/thief)
[![CRAN_Status_Badge](http://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/thief)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=thief)
[![Downloads](http://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/thief)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=thief)
[![Licence](https://img.shields.io/badge/licence-GPL--3-blue.svg)](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.en.html)

The R package *thief* provides methods and tools for generating
forecasts at different temporal frequencies using a hierarchical time
series approach.

Authors: Rob J Hyndman and Nikolaos Kourentzes

This package implements the methods described in

[Athanasopoulos, G., Hyndman, R.J., Kourentzes, N., and Petropoulos, F.
(2016) Forecasting with temporal
hierarchies.](http://robjhyndman.com/publications/temporal-hierarchies/)

## Installation

You can install the **stable** version on [R
CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=thief).

``` r

install.packages('thief', dependencies = TRUE)
```

You can install the **development** version from
[Github](https://github.com/robjhyndman/thief)

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("robjhyndman/thief")
```

## Usage

``` s
library(thief)
thief(USAccDeaths)
```

## License

This package is free and open source software, licensed under GPL 3.

# Package index

## Main function

Produce forecasts using the THieF method

- [`thief()`](http://robjhyndman.github.io/thief/reference/thief.md) :
  Temporal hierarchical forecasting

## Helper functions

- [`tsaggregates()`](http://robjhyndman.github.io/thief/reference/tsaggregates.md)
  : Non-overlapping temporal aggregation of a time series
- [`reconcilethief()`](http://robjhyndman.github.io/thief/reference/reconcilethief.md)
  : Reconcile temporal hierarchical forecasts

## Plotting functions

- [`plot(`*`<tsaggregates>`*`)`](http://robjhyndman.github.io/thief/reference/plot.tsaggregates.md)
  [`autoplot(`*`<tsaggregates>`*`)`](http://robjhyndman.github.io/thief/reference/plot.tsaggregates.md)
  : Plot time series aggregates

## Data

- [`AEdemand`](http://robjhyndman.github.io/thief/reference/AEdemand.md)
  : Accident and Emergency demand in the UK
